title: Peruvian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy Peruvian-inspired chicken wrap, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Grill or cook the chicken in a skillet until cooked through.
Slice the chicken into thin strips.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Spread the Peruvian aji amarillo sauce on the wrap.
Top with sliced chicken, red onion, cilantro, and hard-boiled egg.
Drizzle with additional aji amarillo sauce if desired.
